anchors.name: sota_ref_n6
anchors.derivation: smallest published ternary radius-1 covering for 6 matches per Keri's ternary table (K_3(6,1) row '71-73'); code found by simulated annealing in van Laarhoven-Aarts-van Lint-Wille, JCTA Ser. A 52 (1989) 304-312; lower bound 71 (Linderoth-Margot-Thain 2007), not proven optimal

anchors.name: sota_ref_n7
anchors.derivation: smallest published covering for 7 matches per Keri's table (row '156-186'); van Laarhoven et al. 1989; lower bound 156 (Haas 2006), not proven optimal; still the record per OEIS A004044 comment of June 2021

anchors.name: sota_ref_n8
anchors.derivation: smallest published covering for 8 matches per Keri's table (row '402-486'); van Laarhoven et al. 1989; lower bound 402 (Haas 2006), not proven optimal

anchors.name: sota_ref_n9
anchors.derivation: smallest published covering for 9 matches per Keri's table (row '1060-1269'); Di Pasquale-Ostergard, JCTA Ser. A (2003), https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0097316503000104 ; lower bound 1060 (Habsieger 1996), not proven optimal

anchors.name: sota_ref_n10
anchors.derivation: smallest published covering for 10 matches per Keri's table (row '2854-3645', upper marker 's' = Blokhuis-Lam 1984); lower bound 2854 (Haas 2002), not proven optimal
